description: Token balances and prices with pagination; filter by network_keys. → get_total_asset for portfolio summary only.

account_id.description: Account ID (optional, auto-detected from login session)

mcp_token.description: MCP session token obtained from login (dex_auth_google_login_poll or dex_auth_gate_login_poll). MUST be provided in every call to this tool after login; omitting it will result in 403

network_keys.description: Optional. Comma-separated network keys to filter (e.g. ETH,SOL,ARB). Omit or leave empty for all networks. Do not pass a separate chain field — use network_keys only.

name: dex_wallet_get_token_list
